analysis.summary: In FY 2025-26, Manaksia Steels Limited recorded total revenue of Rs 1,053.19 Crore, growing 80.3% over FY 2024-25. Profit after tax rose 226.24% to Rs 38.17 Crore, supported by operating leverage and the commissioning of its new 1,10,200 TPA Alu-Zinc coating line. The company targets consolidated revenue of Rs 1,500 Crore in FY 2026-27 and Rs 3,000 Crore in FY 2028-29 following further capacity expansions. Manaksia Steels carried no long-term debt at the end of FY 2025-26, funding its expansion through internal accruals. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and an EBITDA of H25.69 Crore.

guidance.claim: The colour coating line investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: The company aims to address the growing demand for value-added flat steel from the construction, warehousing, manufacturing, home appliances, and engineering sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company seeks to address the growing need for value-added flat steel from the country’s construction, warehousing, manufacturing, home appliances and engineering sectors.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.
capex_expansion.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased by 226.24% from Rs 11.70 Crore in FY 2024-25 to Rs 38.17 Crore in FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 226.24% from H11.70 Crore in FY 2024-25 to H38.17 Crore, representing an incremental growth of H26.47 Crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's expansion programme is funded through net worth and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are poised to double our installed capacity through net worth.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remained fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
